changelog: Shotgun MAGs, Nanopore: Medaka polishing is now an option in step 4 (off by default) and runs at 4 threads. At 8 threads, polishing the Zymo Nanopore assembly took the whole WSL down on nextapp (28 GB) and the running job with it. For R10 / SUP reads Flye's own consensus is usually enough; turn it on for older R9 data, where unpolished contigs make CheckM2 understate completeness.

previous.changelog: Shotgun MAGs: 2.20.4 stopped at the end of the MAG step ("'PosixPath' object has no attribute 'get'") whenever the GTDB database was installed — the GTDB step reused the name of the joined-bins table. Fixed, and the whole MAG step (split, join, GTDB, AMRFinderPlus, bin table) is now run end to end with stand-in tools before release. The profile and resistome were never affected.
